sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Filtering and sorting a multi-section page that shows cover-art thumbnails is much quicker. Every re-render has to copy each visible thumbnail back onto the row it came from, so it survives the next one, and finding that row meant searching the whole table once per thumbnail. On a 4174-row page that search cost about 1.5 seconds of frozen page per keystroke, and about 13 seconds on a 10 000-row one; it now builds one lookup table per pass instead, costing about 2.4 milliseconds. Thumbnails behave exactly as before.
